name: Pidgeon Email
description: Email channel for OpenClaw: mail to your agent's own address starts a conversation and gets a reply in its thread. Resumes after restarts and dropped connections; holds prompt-injection mail before the agent sees it.

pidgeon.label: Pidgeon
pidgeon.description: Email to your agent's Pidgeon address, as OpenClaw conversations.

uiHints.label: Pidgeon
uiHints.help: Sign in with `openclaw channels login --channel pidgeon`, or set PIDGEON_API_KEY in the Gateway's environment.

apiKeyEnv.label: API key variable
apiKeyEnv.help: The environment variable holding a Pidgeon API key. Defaults to PIDGEON_API_KEY. The key itself never goes in this file.

addresses.label: Addresses
addresses.help: Which of your Pidgeon addresses start conversations. Empty means every address the credential reaches.

dmPolicy.label: Who can start a conversation
dmPolicy.help: "open" (default): anyone who can reach the address. "allowlist": only the senders in allowFrom. "disabled": nobody.

allowFrom.label: Allowed senders
allowFrom.help: Addresses, or @domain.com for a whole domain. Used when dmPolicy is "allowlist".

allowUnauthenticated.label: Trust unauthenticated senders
allowUnauthenticated.help: Off (default): an allowed sender's mail reaches the agent only when it passes DMARC, because anyone can forge a From address. On: the From alone decides, as before 0.1.1. Leave it off unless a sender you allow cannot pass DMARC.

suspicious.label: Mail the Firewall flags
suspicious.help: "hold" (default): kept in the inbox and not given to the agent. "deliver": given to the agent with the Firewall's warning.
